This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy. Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand and manage a portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth. Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance. Conduct in-depth agency diagnostics to assess performance and identify growth opportunities. Prospect, onboard and set performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support. May pre-qualify accounts as needed. Collaborate with internal teams, such as, Product and Underwriting to ensure alignment of sales strategies with business objectives. Understand Travelers Enterprise focus and seize opportunities to cross-sell Travelers products by discussing with business partners in other lines. May identify book transfer opportunities. Utilize advanced data and analytics for sales decisions and performance measurement, leveraging extensive knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process. Leverage AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools. Strong influencing and negotiation skills to encourage agency partners to adopt Travelers products and services. Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to define goals and priorities and meet these goals in a timely manner. Exceptional organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities to meet sales goals and deadlines effectively. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox's Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. The team provides support to Roblox's global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Lead, Product Support Ops on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll be mentor and lead the team that is focused on Escalations, Product Reliability, Process Improvement and Design and plays a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform. Your team will be responsible for identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager and leading the Support Operations Excellence team, providing coverage across billing, accounts, creator, and adjacent domains. This is a player-coach role, weighted toward leadership. You'll still go deep on the hardest problems and stay close enough to the work to be a genuine execution expert, but your primary leverage is the team, and you'll be measured on what they collectively deliver.
The Product Support Management (PSM) team is your most important partner. You and your team supply the synthesis, evidence, and prioritization that enable PSM and engineering to fix problems at the source, and you are accountable for the quality of what reaches them.

Lead and develop the team
Manage, coach, and grow a team of four Product Support Specialists, owning onboarding, performance, and career development. You’ll set direction and hold the quality of output for the team. Coach them to grow their scope and operate with independence.
Set clear standards for what good looks like at each level, and give direct, specific, and frequent feedback against them.
Represent the team's work, constraints, and priorities to leadership and to cross-functional partners.
Partner with the Product Support Management team
Serve as the primary point of contact between the PSS team and PSM, ensuring the issues your team surfaces arrive with the synthesis, evidence, and recommendation needed to act on them.
Own the quality bar for what your team escalates into the PSM and engineering prioritization process.
Ensure RCAs are completed, documented, socialized with the right stakeholders, and work with the PSM team to ensure they are translated into changes that prevent recurrence.
Step in personally on the highest-stakes and most ambiguous problems, and partner with the PSM team to make the call when the path forward is unclear.
Drive support health and operational excellence
Co-own the health of product support across your domains: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where users are getting stuck.
Turn patterns into prioritized action: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, and product gaps get surfaced with a recommendation.
Hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, and eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling.
Support Launches:
Get ahead of launches: make sure upcoming product and policy changes are pressure-tested from a support perspective, and that content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before users feel the change.
Contribute to the successful launch of new support streams and initiatives by providing subject matter expertise, process guidance, and team capacity.
Partner closely with the PSM team to establish a regular feedback loop on support health proactively identifying areas of strength, flagging degrading performance, and driving actionable mitigation plans.
Vendor & Escalation Quality:
Partner with vendor operations (BPO/Tier 1) to establish feedback loops that improve first-contact resolution, reduce bad escalations, and ensure frontline agents are enabled on critical product changes.
Knowledge & Support ContentOwn knowledge and scaled support
Co-own the accuracy/ information within support content that agents depend on along with PSMs, ensuring workflows, policies and guidance are accurate and up to date. Ensure support content which includes but is not limited to, troubleshooting guides, decision trees, structured resolution paths, policy interpretations are clear, current, and reliable for the support agents who use it.
Partner with Knowledge Management, Training, and Quality teams to align documentation, agent enablement, and quality control with what the data says users actually need.
You Have
8+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
Direct people management experience, including ownership of performance and career development, with a track record of developing individuals and raising the collective performance of a team.
A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues, and the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to delegate.
Experience owning incident response for high-severity issues, including coordinating cross-functional teams under time pressure.
Breadth across multiple support domains, or clear evidence you can get up to speed on an unfamiliar one quickly.
Excellent written communication. You can explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer, to a frustrated user, and to leadership, and all three come away clearer.
Strong cross-functional influence without authority.
Comfort with ambiguity. You set direction for your team when the problem space is not yet well defined.
Willingness to participate in on-call support when needed.
You Are
A Leader: Your team does better work because of you, and that shows up in their output and their growth.
Analytical: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous problems, and to measure both the problems and the solutions.
A proactive problem solver: You anticipate problems and take decisive action rather than waiting for them to escalate to you.
Team-oriented: You lift up your peers and find ways to make the wider organization stronger, not just your own team.
Data-driven: You use data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decisions.
Nice to Have
Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
Experience building or scaling a support team through a period of significant growth or change.
Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience alongside a general consumer base.
Experience working with BPO or outsourced support partners.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Technical Partnership
: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
Joint Solution Development:
Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
Customer Deal Support:
Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
Partner Ecosystem & Events
: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
Product Feedback:
Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.
Preferred qualifications
5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager
Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
Fluent in Korean and English
Logistics
Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다.
Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다.우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다. Coupang Ads 구성원들은 Coupang Ads를 일하기 좋은 곳으로 만드는데 큰 역할을 하며, 우리는 빠르게 변화하는 역동적인 환경에서 일하고 싶어하는 다양한 배경을 가진 사람들을 고용하고 개발하며, 각 직원이 존중과 권한을 부여 받고 지원받는다고 느낄 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다. 이런 환경과 사람들은 광고주를 대신하여 혁신적인 관점을 제공할 수 있습니다. 우리는 고객중심의 생각, 끈기, 사려 깊음, 그리고 신속한 행동을 직접 보여줄 수 있는 자질을 중요하게 생각합니다.
우리의 목표는 세계 최고의 광고 팀에서 일하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 만드는 것입니다. 혁신적이고 역동적인 환경에서 업계를 선도하고, 팀과 함께 성장을 달성하고자 하는 열정적인 분이라면 Coupang Ads와 함께하세요. Coupang Ads에서 여러분은 세계에서 가장 가치 있고 가장 빠르게 성장하는 광고 솔루션 중 하나를 제공하게 될 것입니다.
직무 소개
플랫폼과 이커머스 광고에 대한 이해를 기반으로 광고주의 니즈에 따라 세일즈 방안을 수립하고 지원하는 Coupang Ads의 중소형 광고주 영업 (Small and Medium Business) 조직은 2019년 설립이래, 매년 전년대비 2배 이상의 성장을 이뤄내고 있습니다.
쿠팡에 입점한 중소/중견 셀러중에서 키워드 검색 및 브랜드 광고 등을 진행하고 있는 광고주의 매출 성장을 목표로 세일즈 방안을 수립하고 지원합니다. Coupang Ads 조직 내부의 기준에 따른 광고주 Pool내에서 아웃바운드 세일즈를 진행합니다. 쿠팡내 매출과 광고 전환 매출의 상관 관계 및 시즌 트렌드 등의 관련된 데이터를 기반으로 광고 전략을 수립해 제안함으로써 광고주의 광고 만족도를 높이고, 광고 매출을 극대화합니다.

jobs.description: A career at Auto-Owners is challenging and rewarding. Our group of caring associates create financial security by helping individuals and businesses make a new start when a loss occurs. Job Description We offer a merit-based work-from-home program based on job responsibilities. After initial training in-person, this specific role could have the flexibility to work from home up to 3 days per week. Auto-Owners Insurance, a top-rated insurance carrier, is seeking a motivated individual to join our Claims department as a Bodily Injury Claims Representative. The position requires the person to: Assemble facts, determine coverage, evaluate the amount of loss, analyze legal liability, make payments in accordance with coverage, damage and liability determination, and perform other functions or duties to properly adjust the loss. Study insurance policies, endorsements, and forms to develop an understanding of insurance coverage. Follow claims handling procedures and participate in claim negotiations and settlements. Deliver a high level of customer service to our agents, insureds, and others. Devise alternative approaches to provide appropriate service, dependent upon the circumstances. Meet with people involved with claims, sometimes outside of our office environment. Handle investigations by telephone, email, mail, and on-site investigations. Maintain appropriate adjuster’s license(s), if required by statute in the jurisdiction employed, within the time frame prescribed by the Company or statute. Handle complex and unusual exposure claims effectively through on-site investigations and through participation in mediations, settlement conferences, and trials. Handle confidential information according to Company standards and in accordance with any applicable law, regulation, or rule. Assist in the evaluation and selection of outside counsel. Maintain punctual attendance according to an assigned work schedule at a Company approved work location. Desired Skills & Experience A minimum of three years of insurance claims related experience. The ability to organize and conduct an investigation involving complex issues and assimilate the information to reach a logical and timely decision. The ability to effectively understand, interpret and communicate policy language. The dissemination of appropriate claim handling techniques so that others involved in the claim process are understanding of issues. Own and uphold the product vision and design standards for our live titles and new products from concept through release and post-launch analysis
Design features, systems, and live ops events grounded in player research and behavioural data, with measurable impact on engagement, retention, and monetisation

Collaborate closely with development, art, product, production, and marketing to keep designs aligned and execution smooth

7+ years in game design with proven experience leading or mentoring a design team
Strong portfolio of shipped features and titles demonstrating design craft and commercial impact; direct experience in social casino or bingo titles preferred
Hands-on across the full development lifecycle: market research, prototyping, development, live ops, post-launch analysis and LiveOps
Deep expertise in economy design, balancing, and progression systems, with a strong grasp of mobile UX principles and player journey design
Analytical fluency with key mobile metrics and player behaviour, including practical experience designing and interpreting A/B tests
Practical experience using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate ideation, documentation, balance modelling, and team communication
Excellent written communicator and cross-functional collaborator, comfortable navigating production trade-offs and influencing senior stakeholders with clear, well-evidenced recommendations
Passion for games and genuine player empathy
